# Remaining execution gates

Generated by the new static/runtime-contract gates.

## Gates added

- `nginx-compose-dns-gate`: validates Nginx upstream hostnames against compose service names, container names, and network aliases.
- `service-port-gate`: validates drift-prone service ports and prevents ERP/Odoo legacy DNS aliases from leaking to non-ERP services.
- `runtime-contract-gate`: verifies runnable contracts exist for tenant/auth live probes, weather-signal chain, and raster-tiler ownership.

## Live script added

`scripts/e2e/tenant_auth_live_gate.py` runs against an already-running stack and checks reject paths for:

- public AI `current_field_state` injection
- AI/RAG tenant mismatch
- RAG ingest without service token
- Knowledge Graph writes without service token
